moral.zh: 水结冰时结构变得疏松，同样质量占的体积更大，密度比水小，所以冰会浮起。
moral.en: When water freezes, its structure becomes more open, making ice less dense than liquid water so it floats.

pages.zhText: 厨房里，冰块“扑通”跳进水杯。小雨问：“冰为什么浮在水面？”
pages.enText: In the kitchen, an ice cube plops into a glass. “Why does ice float?” Xiaoyu asks.

pages.zhText: 所以，同样多的水结成冰，体积变大，密度变小，冰就更容易浮起。
pages.enText: So the same amount of water takes up more space as ice. Ice is less dense, which helps it float.

pages.zhText: 湖面也会这样：上层先结冰，冰层像被子，减慢水的散热，保护水下生物。
pages.enText: A lake does this too. The top freezes first, and the ice layer slows heat loss like a blanket, protecting life below.

pages.enText: Xiaoyu nods. “The open structure makes ice less dense!” Then she asks, “Why can a hot-air balloon fly?”
